newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF institute says April index up 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF institute says April index up 0.2 pct.

text.p: The Swiss Institute for Business Cycle Research (KOF), part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich (ETH), said that its April economic index rose 0.2 percent versus March.
The index was also up 1.2 percent versus April 1996.
It said that the orders on hand in the machinery industry had risen slightly for the first time since the second quarter of 1995, and the declines in its construction indicator had continued to slow.
Swiss business conditions in the first quarter of 1997 were also revised upward, KOF said.
"The values for the first quarter, based on definitive data for the building sector and orders on hand in the machinery industry, were corrected upward," KOF said.
It also said the revised seasonally adjusted first quarter data were above an average value for all indicators for the first time since 1994.
KOF also said it remained by its forecast for a slight recovery in the second half of 1997.

KOF makes forecasts based on an array of different indices including data from industry, the building sector, retail and wholesale trade, tourism and the related service sector, consumer credit, money supply and employment.
